en.answer: The third effect of <<12640>> can be activated when a Gemini monster is Normal Summoned, by either you or your opponent.
en.question: Can the effect of <<12640>> that makes my opponent send a card from their hand or field to the Graveyard be activated even when my opponent Normal Summons a Gemini monster?
en.title: Can the effect of <<12640>> that makes my opponent send a card from their hand or field to the Graveyard be activated even when my opponent Normal Summons a Gemini monster?
